channel.title: eala energy — Insights
channel.description: Insights from eala energy on distributed AI compute, curtailed renewable power and the energy-resilience layer.

item.title: Why long money doesn’t go where the curtailment is
item.description: Behind the Scottish constraint, a battery may have three to five strong years; lenders want seven to ten. What kind of project fits that window?

item.title: How many hours can Britain’s batteries actually store?
item.description: Britain’s 8.7 GW battery fleet holds 14.1 GWh, about an hour and a half at full output. Why storage duration, and a load at the node, matter.
